section: Scheduled Tribes - Forest Rights Act 2006, Fifth and Sixth Schedules, TSP, Eklavya schools

accepted.s: The category of tribal groups initially known as Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PTGs) was created in which year?
accepted.x: The category was created as Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PTGs) in 1973.
accepted.tq: Use direct year-based recall while distinguishing PTGs from the later PVTG terminology.

accepted.s: The term ‘Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups’ replaced ‘Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PTGs)’ in:
accepted.x: The groups were renamed PVTGs in 2006.
accepted.tq: Test the confusable distinction between the original classification and its later name.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a criterion used for identifying Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups?
accepted.x: Very low literacy, not very high literacy, is one of the criteria. The other listed features are recognised criteria for PVTGs.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed descriptive criterion in an EXCEPT-style question.

accepted.s: PM-JANMAN, also known as the PM PVTG Development Mission, is associated with which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: PM-JANMAN or the PM PVTG Development Mission is implemented by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘which ministry’ trap to distinguish the nodal ministry from neighbouring ministries.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about PM-JANMAN:
1. It covers 75 PVTGs.
2. Its implementation period is from 2023-24 to 2027-28.
3. It involves an outlay of ₹15,000 crore.
4. Its interventions include housing, water, health, roads and livelihood support.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: PM-JANMAN covers all 75 PVTGs, operates from 2023-24 to 2027-28, has an outlay of ₹15,000 crore and includes the listed basic-services and livelihood interventions.
accepted.tq: Check whether all components of a mission profile—coverage, period, amount and objectives—are correctly retained.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs correctly represents two PVTGs included in the undivided Andhra Pradesh list?
accepted.x: Chenchu and Thoti are among the 12 PVTGs in the undivided Andhra Pradesh list.
accepted.tq: Use place-linked tribal names to identify the correct regional pair.

accepted.s: How many PVTGs were included in the undivided Andhra Pradesh list?
accepted.x: The undivided Andhra Pradesh list contained 12 PVTGs.
accepted.tq: Test a precise regional count with nearby numerical distractors.

accepted.s: Which one of the following sets consists entirely of PVTGs included in the undivided Andhra Pradesh list?
o: Chenchu, Bodo Gadaba, Gutob Gadaba and Dongria Khond
accepted.x: Chenchu, Bodo Gadaba, Gutob Gadaba and Dongria Khond are all included in the 12-member undivided Andhra Pradesh list given for PVTGs.
accepted.tq: Verify the regional list as a complete set rather than relying on recognition of one familiar name.

accepted.s: The Tribal Sub-Plan strategy originated from the recommendations of an expert committee constituted by the:
o: Ministry of Education and Social Welfare
accepted.x: The Tribal Sub-Plan strategy emerged from an expert committee of the Ministry of Education and Social Welfare in 1972.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct institutional origin instead of the commonly associated planning body.

accepted.s: The Tribal Sub-Plan was first adopted during the:
accepted.x: The Tribal Sub-Plan was first adopted in the Fifth Five Year Plan, beginning in 1974.
accepted.tq: Link a policy innovation to its correct plan period and avoid adjacent-plan confusion.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the Tribal Sub-Plan is correct?
o: It earmarks funds below the proportion of the ST population to prioritise general schemes.
It earmarks funds at least in proportion to the ST population, over and above normal plan flows.
It applies only to urban tribal populations.
It provides funds exclusively through private institutions.
accepted.x: TSP funds are to be at least proportional to the ST population and additional to normal plan flows or general benefits.
accepted.tq: Apply the core rule of proportional and additional funding to a policy scenario.

accepted.s: The Tribal Sub-Plan is presently referred to as the:
o: Development Action Plan for SCs בלבד
Scheduled Tribe Component or Development Action Plan for STs
accepted.x: The Tribal Sub-Plan is now referred to as the Scheduled Tribe Component or Development Action Plan for STs (DAPST).
accepted.tq: Separate the present name of the ST-focused plan from the similarly named SC plan.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Plan or component)
a. Tribal Sub-Plan
b. Special Component Plan
c. Development Action Plan for STs

List-II (Associated description)
i. Present form of the ST-focused plan
 ii. Originated in 1972 and was adopted in the Fifth Plan
 iii. Later known as SCSP and now DAPSC

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The Tribal Sub-Plan originated in 1972 and was adopted in the Fifth Plan; the Special Component Plan became SCSP and later DAPSC; DAPST is the present ST-focused form.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure historical pair and then match the present nomenclature.

accepted.s: The Special Component Plan was introduced in 1979 and was later known as SCSP from:
accepted.x: The Special Component Plan originated in 1979 and came to be known as SCSP in 2006; it is now referred to as DAPSC.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the origin year from the year of renaming and the present designation.

accepted.s: The monitoring of the Tribal Sub-Plan was shifted to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in:
accepted.x: TSP monitoring was shifted from the Planning Commission to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in January 2017.
accepted.tq: Test a precise administrative-transition date with closely spaced alternatives.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. TSP monitoring moved from the Planning Commission to the Ministry of Tribal Affairs in January 2017.
2. Online monitoring covers the ST component of 41 ministries.
3. The Andhra Pradesh law of 2013 made proportional allocation binding at the State level.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The monitoring shift occurred in January 2017, online monitoring covers 41 ministries, and Andhra Pradesh enacted a 2013 law binding proportional allocation.
accepted.tq: Combine administrative monitoring facts with a State-level legislative development.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh SC Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan Act, 2013 is significant because it was the first State law to:
o: make proportional allocation of funds binding
abolish all centrally sponsored tribal schemes
transfer all tribal schools to local bodies
establish the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
accepted.x: The Act was the first State law to make proportional allocation for SCs and STs binding.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinctive legal effect of a State enactment rather than its implementing campaign.

accepted.s: Which campaign publicised the Andhra Pradesh SC Sub-Plan and Tribal Sub-Plan Act, 2013?
accepted.x: The Indiramma Kalalu campaign in April 2013 publicised the Andhra Pradesh law.
accepted.tq: Use the campaign–law association to distinguish a State initiative from national tribal programmes.

accepted.s: Eklavya Model Residential Schools are a Central Sector scheme under the:
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
accepted.x: EMRS is a Central Sector scheme under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
accepted.tq: Apply the ministry-ownership trap to a residential education scheme.

accepted.s: Eklavya Model Residential Schools are run through which organisation?
accepted.x: EMRS are run through the National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS).
accepted.tq: Discriminate among similarly associated tribal institutions by their functional role.

accepted.s: Eklavya Model Residential Schools were modelled on the:
accepted.x: EMRS were modelled on Navodaya Vidyalayas.
accepted.tq: Test the institutional model behind the scheme using nearby residential-school alternatives.

accepted.s: According to the prescribed norm, an EMRS is to be established in every block having:
o: More than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal people
More than 40% ST population and at least 15,000 tribal people
More than 25% ST population and at least 10,000 tribal people
More than 60% ST population and at least 25,000 tribal people
accepted.x: The norm is one EMRS in every block with more than 50% ST population and at least 20,000 tribal people.
accepted.tq: Retain both thresholds together; changing either percentage or population makes the option wrong.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about EMRS:
1. The scheme started in 1997-98.
2. Its target is 740 schools.
3. Day-boarding schools were merged into EMRS.
4. Odisha has the highest number of EMRS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: EMRS began in 1997-98, the target is 740 schools, day-boarding schools were merged into the scheme, and Odisha has the most EMRS.
accepted.tq: Check scheme history, target, structural change and geographical concentration together.

accepted.s: Under SANKALP, how many skill laboratories are associated with EMRS?
accepted.x: Four hundred skill labs are associated with EMRS under SANKALP.
accepted.tq: Test a scheme-linked figure using closely spaced quantitative distractors.

accepted.s: Which organisation runs the tribal residential schools of Andhra Pradesh referred to as Gurukulam?
accepted.x: The tribal residential schools in Andhra Pradesh are run by the Andhra Pradesh Tribal Welfare Residential Educational Institutions Society (APTWREIS), known as Gurukulam.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the State implementing society from the national EMRS organisation.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: EMRS — SC hostel component of PM-AJAY
Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana — PM-AJAY
NESTS — National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
accepted.x: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana, relating to SC hostels, is now part of PM-AJAY. The other pairs confuse distinct institutions or functions.
accepted.tq: Use institution-function matching and reject swapped organisational identities.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the reported Andhra Pradesh EMRS-related figure?
o: Twenty EMRS students were selected to meet President Murmu on 26 January 2026.
Ten EMRS teachers were selected to meet the Vice-President on 15 September 2025.
Ten EMRS students were selected to meet President Murmu on 15 September 2026.
Ten EMRS students were selected to meet the Prime Minister on 15 August 2026.
accepted.x: Ten EMRS students from Andhra Pradesh were chosen to meet President Murmu on 15 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Check the complete event combination of number, persons, date and office-holder.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding tribal and social welfare residential institutions in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There are 734 pre-matric and 300 post-matric SC hostels.
2. There are 17 Ananda Nilayams.
3. Tribal welfare runs 371 Ashram schools.
4. The Ashram schools have 1.65 lakh students.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh has 734 pre-matric and 300 post-matric SC hostels, 17 Ananda Nilayams, and 371 Tribal Welfare Ashram schools with 1.65 lakh students.
accepted.tq: Combine several State-level institutional figures and identify the complete coded combination.

accepted.s: The reported SSC pass percentage of Social Welfare residential schools in Andhra Pradesh was:
accepted.x: Social Welfare residential schools recorded an SSC pass percentage of 89%.
accepted.tq: Test a precise performance indicator with percentage distractors around the correct value.

accepted.s: The National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST) came into existence on 19 February 2004 under:
accepted.x: NCST was established on 19 February 2004 under Article 338A, inserted through the 89th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003.
accepted.tq: Match a constitutional body with its precise Article and establishment date.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the NCST:
1. It was created through the 89th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003.
2. It functions under Article 338A.
3. It was established on 19 February 2004.
4. It possesses powers of a civil court.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the NCST: its constitutional basis is Article 338A, created by the 89th Amendment, operational from 19 February 2004, with civil-court powers.
accepted.tq: Verify the body through amendment, Article, date and institutional power rather than one isolated fact.

accepted.s: TRIFED was established in:
accepted.x: TRIFED was established in 1987.
accepted.tq: Use a direct institutional year question with nearby establishment dates as distractors.

accepted.s: Tribal produce is marketed by TRIFED through the brand:
accepted.x: TRIFED markets tribal produce through the ‘Tribes India’ brand.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the marketing brand from related tribal livelihood initiatives.

accepted.s: The National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC) was established in:
accepted.x: NSTFDC was established in 2001.
accepted.tq: Test the establishment year while separating it from the years of TRIFED, MoTA and NCST.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about NSTFDC is correct?
o: It provides loans only to persons whose income exceeds twice the poverty line.
It is a Section 25 not-for-profit company that provides loans to STs with income up to twice the poverty line.
It markets tribal products exclusively through Tribes India.
It is a constitutional body created under Article 338A.
accepted.x: NSTFDC is a Section 25 not-for-profit company and lends to Scheduled Tribes whose income is up to double the poverty line.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct combination of legal status, beneficiary group and income ceiling.

accepted.s: Which scheme is run by NSTFDC?
accepted.x: NSTFDC runs the Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its associated scheme rather than with a broader tribal programme.

accepted.s: NSTFDC marked its 25th Foundation Day on:
accepted.x: NSTFDC marked its 25th Foundation Day on 10 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine anniversary arithmetic with the exact date to avoid confusing it with the NCST date.

accepted.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Girijan Cooperative Corporation is primarily associated with:
o: Exercising the civil-court powers of NCST
Monitoring the ST component of 41 ministries
accepted.x: The Girijan Cooperative Corporation is associated with marketing tribal produce in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the State institution’s practical function and reject national-level functions.

accepted.s:
The objectives of TADP/ITDA include which of the following?
1. Raising farm output through modern technology, improved seeds and fertilisers.
2. Planting fruit-bearing trees.
3. Undertaking other income-raising activities in tribal areas.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three are objectives of TADP/ITDA: agricultural improvement, fruit-bearing plantations and other income-generating activities in tribal areas.
accepted.tq: Treat each development objective as an independent statement and select the complete combination.

accepted.s: In the ITDA areas of Andhra Pradesh, health schemes are monitored by:
o: ITDA Project Officers and District Scheduled Tribe Welfare officers
NESTS and the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
Only the Ministry of Tribal Affairs
accepted.x: ITDA Project Officers and District Scheduled Tribe Welfare officers monitor health schemes in ITDA areas of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the field-level administrative authorities rather than the national institutions associated with tribal welfare.

accepted.s: Which statement correctly describes the maternal and infant health indicators among tribal populations in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Tribal MMR is below but tribal IMR is above the State average.
Tribal MMR is above but tribal IMR is below the State average.
Both tribal MMR and IMR are below the State average.
Both tribal MMR and IMR are above the State average.
accepted.x: The tribal maternal mortality ratio and infant mortality ratio are both above the State average.
accepted.tq: Read the direction of comparison carefully and avoid reversing one of the two indicators.
